concept.en: Pop repeatedly and collect the results

brief.zh: 写好 stack_reverse(values)。按原顺序把货物放到栈上，再把每次弹出的货物放进新列表。返回这个新列表。
brief.en: Complete stack_reverse(values). Push the supplies in their original order. Put each popped item into a new list and return that list.

hints.zh: 起始代码已经把全部物品放进了 stack。只要它还有东西，就用 pop() 取走栈顶，把取到的物品添加到 result。
hints.en: The starter already pushes every item onto stack. While it contains an item, pop the top and append the item to result.

hints.zh: 光标点到代码末尾，按顺序添加两张补写卡，再运行并保存函数。
hints.en: Click at the end of the code, insert both snippets in order, then run and save your function.

label.en: Pop and save until the stack is empty
